abstract: A study of the incidence and clinical course of testicular germ-cell tumor metastatic to the gastrointestinal tract is presented. Gastrointestinal tract metastasis occurred in 25 cases, 5% of all patients evaluated with germ-cell tumor of the testis. Although embryonal carcinoma was the dominant component in all cases, element of choriocarcinoma were found in 20 cases and HCG was positive in 22 cases. Metastasis occurred most commonly by direct invasion from adjacent tumor. The most frequent site of gastrointestinal involvment was the proximal small intestine. Ivolvement of the duodenum was noted in seven cases. The most common gastrointestinal tract manifestations were intestinal obstruction and gastrointestinal bleeding. Although a variety of therapeutic modalities were tried, the average length of survival from the time of diagnosis of gastrointestinal metastasis to death was six months.
abstract_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の消化管転移の発生頻度と臨床経過を検討した。消化管転移は、評価した患者の5%にあたる25例で認められた。全例で胎児性癌が主要な成分であったが、20例では絨毛癌成分が認められ、22例ではhCGが陽性であった。転移は主に隣接する腫瘍からの直接浸潤により生じた。消化管への病変の好発部位は近位小腸であった。十二指腸病変は7例で認められた。最も多い消化管症状は腸閉塞と消化管出血であった。様々な治療法が試みられたが、消化管転移の診断から死亡までの平均生存期間は約6か月であった。
